description.div: Introducing the Ducky One X, a groundbreaking tri-mode wireless mechanical keyboard equipped with next-gen analog switches! Every keystroke delivers an unparalleled experience with Ducky QUACK Mechanics+ incorporating seven dampening layers coupled with Double Shot, high-density 85% PBT keycaps. Plus, streamline your customization and optimize your performance with the intuitive web-based software. Get ready to elevate your typing experience to new heights with the Ducky One X!Ducky's Next-gen Inductive Switch redefines precision and consistency, delivering 0.1mm key motion accuracy from start to finish (from 0.1mm to 3.5mm). Unlike magnet-based Hall effect switches, which may suffer from inconsistencies or decaying magnet strength, this innovative design ensures consistent, reliable performance and exceptional power efficiency, making it the ideal choice for wireless usage scenarios. These switches pair a composite POM stem with nylon housing for smooth performance no matter what you use them for.Up your game with specialty gaming functions! The popular Rapid trigger function resets the key as soon as you start to release it, giving you the ability to trigger it again without moving up past the actuation point or releasing the key completely. With the Multi-point trigger function, assign four actions to a single key depending on depth of press and release.Black has black top and silver grey bottomWhite has white top and bottom**This keyboard uses specialty analog switches and is not compatible with mechanical or magnetic switches.**

description.div: Lofree once again partnered with Kailh to rethink the switch from its physical structure. The result is something entirely new. The Nexus Mechanical Magnetic Switch is the first switch to truly combine the advantages of both magnetic and mechanical systems. It retains the precision and speed of magnetic actuation, while introducing the feedback and sound of a mechanical structure. In gaming, 0.01mm Rapid Trigger and dual 8K polling deliver faster, more precise input. In everyday use, the mechanical structure and gasket system provide stability, consistency, and a refined feel. At the same time, Hyzen supports hot-swappable compatibility with both magnetic and mechanical switches, allowing you to tailor your typing experience to different needs.The Lofree Hyzen67 keyboard uses Lofree x Kailh Nexus Mechancial Magnetic switches. These switches use magnets and sensors instead of physical contacts to process actuations, creating a much smoother keypress without bounce or chatter. The adjustable actuation point is determined not by location but by distance travelled.Hyzen is built on TMR (Tunnel MagnetoResistance) sensing technology — a next-generation magnetic sensing solution. Unlike traditional Hall Effect sensors that detect magnetic field strength, TMR measures resistance changes, allowing it to capture far more subtle variations in key travel. TMR also offers improved temperature stability, stronger resistance to interference and lower power consumption.Adjustable ActuationAdjust actuation point between 0.01mm to 3.5mm to strike the perfect balance between speed and control.Rapid TriggerKeys can reset and re-trigger instantly, without returning to the top position. This removes the physical limitation of traditional switches, bringing faster repeated inputs, more responsive movement and tighter control in high-speed scenarios.Dynamic Keystroke (DKS)One key. Multiple actions. In FPS games, a single press can smoothly trigger - aim, shoot, reset - allowing complex sequences (up to 4 actions) to happen in one motion.Mod TapTap for one action. Hold for another. In action or RPG games, you can combine - quick skills (tap), charged abilities (hold) - without moving your fingers.ToggleTurn continuous actions on or off. Perfect for auto-run in open-world games or repeated actions in farming or grinding. Free your fingers without losing control.Rapid Successive PriorityWhen multiple keys are pressed, the deeper press takes priority. In competitive scenarios, this ensures intentional actions override accidental ones — critical for movement and control accuracy.SOCD Directional Input ControlManage conflicting inputs like left/right or up/down. Essential in fighting games (clean directional inputs) and PS movement (precise strafing and counter-strafing) to ensure your inputs stay clean and predictable.Hyper TapTrigger multiple inputs with one key. In fast-paced games, this enables - jump + crouch combos, advanced movement shortcuts, complex macros without delay.Tri-mode edition includes:- 2.4 GHz. receiver- USB-C cable- keycap puller- user manualWired edition includes:Includes:- USB-C cable- user manual

list.item: First keyboard built with Ducky Inductive Analog switches - Ducky Inductive switches deliver superior accuracy, consistency, and power efficiency compared to traditional analog switches
Gasket mount design with Ducky plate mount stabilizers on stainless steel plate
Connect 3 ways- wired with USB-C cable or wirelessly with Bluetooth and 2.4 GHz
Connect up to 4 devices

2500mAh Polymer Li-ion battery

description.div: Introducing the Ducky One X, a groundbreaking tri-mode wireless mechanical keyboard equipped with next-gen analog switches! Every keystroke delivers an unparalleled experience with Ducky QUACK Mechanics+ incorporating seven dampening layers coupled with Double Shot, high-density 85% PBT keycaps. Plus, streamline your customization and optimize your performance with the intuitive web-based software. Get ready to elevate your typing experience to new heights with the Ducky One X!Ducky's Next-gen Inductive Switch redefines precision and consistency, delivering 0.1mm key motion accuracy from start to finish (from 0.1mm to 3.5mm). Unlike magnet-based Hall effect switches, which may suffer from inconsistencies or decaying magnet strength, this innovative design ensures consistent, reliable performance and exceptional power efficiency, making it the ideal choice for wireless usage scenarios. These switches pair a composite POM stem with nylon housing for smooth performance no matter what you use them for.Up your game with specialty gaming functions! The popular Rapid trigger function resets the key as soon as you start to release it, giving you the ability to trigger it again without moving up past the actuation point or releasing the key completely. With the Multi-point trigger function, assign four actions to a single key depending on depth of press and release.Black has black top and silver grey bottomWhite has white top and bottom**This keyboard uses specialty analog switches and is not compatible with mechanical or magnetic switches.**
